claims.text: The language pairs explored are Chinese-to-English (CH-EN) and English-to-Japanese (EN-JA).
The CH-EN translation is tested on two datasets: a small dataset with 0.63M sentence pairs and a large dataset with 2.1M sentence pairs.
The EN-JA translation uses the KFTT dataset, which includes 0.44M sentence pairs for training.
